systems.system: Base de dados do registo civil (national civil registration database)

AGO.note: The law obliges health units to send birth data to the civil registry within 72 hours, electronically where possible; it names no health information system or exchange in service, and civil registration is not a health system.

systems.system: Base de dados do registo civil (national civil registration database)
Base de dados da identificação civil (civil identification database)

AGO.note: The law lets the civil registry database be interconnected with the civil identification database and requires birth data sent to social, health and tax services; it states no other system checking people against the national ID.
